description: Turning a non-2xx REST response into the SDK's error. `body` is the raw response text. The server's sentence is kept; `reason` is a stable slug to branch on; a body that is not JSON must degrade to the status alone, never raise a parse error over the real one. `what` is the operation label each call passes.

cases.name: server sentence
cases.message: publish failed: forbidden publish on room:1

cases.name: quota carries a reason
cases.body: {"error":"queue limit reached (3) — upgrade the plan or delete a queue","reason":"queue_limit"}
cases.message: publish failed: queue limit reached (3) — upgrade the plan or delete a queue

cases.name: empty error string falls back to the status
non-string error and reason are ignored
JSON that is not an object
